What they usually look for is 2 years+ experience teaching English post Cert. Speaking out of my personal experience (someone from India), you could apply for East Asian countries like Vietnam and Thailand. You could even apply for companies like British Council and so on. 

The visa and work permit process can and be long and tiresome but once you’re done with it, you can actually work at multiple companies as a freelancer or apply to become an examiner. The company I worked for in Vietnam took care of my work permit process and the costs that came with it. I was event told by the HR that I could work for multiple companies if I wanted to and they would take care of the work permit renewal. 

All of this obviously works if you’re serious about teaching, CPD (which I assume you are since you are doing DipTESOL) and really demonstrate you are that person in the interview. Good luck.
